releaseNotes: ## [2.0.3] — Tester drop (2026-07-20)  ### Added  - Caller-ID name capture v1.1: new opt-in "Capture names from call notifications" (Settings → Calls) reads the name Truecaller / the phone's dialer shows during a call and saves it for that number — the name then labels the number's entire call history. A delayed post-call re-check also catches names OEM dialers write into the call log only after a call ends. - Caller-name sources now have a trust order (notification > call-log name > carrier CNAP); a weaker source never overwrites a stronger one. - New "Caller-name detection health" screen (Settings → Calls) shows what's blocking caller-name capture and fixes each in one tap — notification access, screening role, battery optimisation, and (on Xiaomi/Oppo/realme/vivo/OnePlus) autostart.  ### Fixed  - Notification-based caller-name capture now reads the name from Android 12+ call notifications correctly (it lives in a "Person" field, not the title), so many more calls that show a name on screen now save that name. Also reads call notifications from any app, covers more OEM caller-ID components, and no longer drops valid business names.  ### Changed  - Calls list: unsaved calls now show a light-blue row background (missed stays red); caller-ID names learned once now appear on all calls from that number. - Statistics/Insights charts: date labels render as "20/07" with a small month so they never clip; Top callers shows saved or caller-ID names instead of bare numbers. - Call detail: all action buttons (including Save to contacts) stay on one line. - More page: Quick export row hidden for now. - Follow-ups/Bookmarks (and all empty states): center icon properly centered. - Calls page: "Unsaved inquiries" section starts collapsed.
